node.label: Reduced tissue alpha-N-acetylglucosaminidase activity
node.definition: Concentration or activity of alpha-N-acetylglucosaminidase (EC 3.2.1.50) below the lower limit of normal. This enzyme can be measured in multiple tissues including leukocytes and cultured fibroblasts. It is also known as alpha-acetylglucosaminidase, N-acetyl-alpha-D-glucosaminidase, N-acetyl-alpha-glucosaminidase, and alpha-D-2-acetamido-2-deoxyglucosidase.

evidence.snippet: Mucopolysaccharidosis type IIIB: Reduced tissue alpha-N-acetylglucosaminidase activity (frequency 7/7) [PCS]
